attribution: All contest data is public ham-radio knowledge — names, sponsor URLs, and date formulas as published by the sponsors themselves.

whenComputedSyntax.nth-weekend-of:<MM>:<n>[:Sat|Sun[±d]]: nth FULL Sat+Sun weekend; n=-1 last, -2 second-to-last. :Sun = its Sunday; :Sat-1 = the Friday before.
whenComputedSyntax.nth-weekday-of:<MM>:<n>:<Day>[±d]: nth weekday of the month, e.g. '4:3:Sun' = third Sunday of April; ±d shifts by days ('9:1:Mon+5' = Saturday after Labor Day).
whenComputedSyntax.weekday-nearest:<MM-DD>:<Day>[±d]: The <Day> closest to a date (weekend closest to Sep 27).
whenComputedSyntax.weekday-on-or-after:<MM-DD>:<Day>[±d]: First <Day> on or after a date.
whenComputedSyntax.weekday-on-or-before:<MM-DD>:<Day>[±d]: Last <Day> on or before a date.
whenComputedSyntax.range:<MM-DD>:<MM-DD>: Starts on the first date each year; durationHours sets the end.
whenComputedSyntax.monthly-first-weekend: First full Sat+Sun weekend of every month.
whenComputedSyntax.monthly-nth:<n>:<Day>[±d]: e.g. 'monthly-nth:3:Mon' = third Monday of each month.
whenComputedSyntax.custom:<text>: No formula — whenRule is shown; dates may come from explicitWindows.
whenComputedSyntax.:HHMMz suffix: UTC start time for any non-weekly form (default 0000z).
whenComputedSyntax.;YYYY=MM-DD suffix: Sponsor moved that one year of an annual rule.

contests.name: Route 66 On The Air
contests.whenRule: 9 days starting 0001z the Saturday after Labor Day (US), through 2359z the second Sunday
contests.notes: 22 special-event stations (W6A-W6T, W6W, W6Z) operate from cities along historic Route 66, Chicago to Santa Monica, plus four rovers; mobiles sign /m66. Working any ONE station on any band or mode earns the certificate (mail-in application, no clean sweep, no log submission); QSL each station direct with an SASE. Suggested frequencies - CW: 3.533, 7.033, 10.110, 14.033, 18.080, 21.033, 24.900, 28.033, 50.033. SSB: 3.866, 7.266, 14.266, 18.164, 21.366, 24.966, 28.466, 50.166. FT8 on the standard dials. Stations self-spot on the DX cluster.
